providers.name: Galaxy, procedurally generated by scripts/generate-procedural-textures.mjs (no third-party material)

review.note: Checked live (2026-08-26): same situation as Miranda — no controlled global mosaic published by USGS, single-flyby Voyager 2 coverage only. Procedural texture: Voyager 2 imaging science found Ariel is Uranus's brightest/youngest-surfaced moon with few large craters and many small ones (recent low-impact resurfacing erased older large craters) — rendered as many small craters, no large basins.
